Convert simulacr objects to epicontacts

Source: R/as_epicontacts.R
as_epicontacts.Rd

The function as_epicontacts is a generic with a method for simulacr objects as returned by simulate_outbreak().

Usage

as_epicontacts(...)

# S3 method for class 'simulacr'
as_epicontacts(x, cases_only = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

...

Further arguments to be passed to other methods.

x

A simulacr object returned by simulate_outbreak().

cases_only

A logical indicating if cases only should be included in the converted object; defaults to FALSE.

Author

Thibaut Jombart, Cyril Geismar

Examples


## simulate an outbreak
x <- simulate_outbreak(
  n = 100, duration = 50, tau = 0.3, 
  contacts = make_random_contacts(100, 5)
)

## conversions to epicontacts and igraph
as_epicontacts(x)
